answers.rationale: The requirement specifies details about terminal blocks and wiring within the switchgear. Based on the catalog, the CROWN-ARMV product is the appropriate choice as it is the default for metal-clad switchgear lines, which would include terminal blocks and wiring.

The requirement pertains to the representation of devices within the switchgear enclosure. The CROWN-ARMV product is suitable as it is the default for metal-clad switchgear lines, which would include the specified devices and their arrangement.
The requirement specifies control and lockout switches within the switchgear. The CROWN-ARMV product is the default for metal-clad switchgear lines, which would include these components.

The requirement specifies protective relays and relay programming for operational switchgear. The EP2-RPP product is the appropriate choice as it is designed for protective relays and substation relay and protection panels, including relay programming and settings.

The requirement specifies the mounting of instruments, relays, and control devices on the switchgear front doors. The CROWN-ARMV product is the default for metal-clad switchgear lines, which would include these features.

The requirement specifies the material for the main contacts and secondary disconnecting devices in the switchgear. The CROWN-ARMV product is the default for metal-clad switchgear lines, which would include these components.

The requirement specifies accessories and spare parts for the switchgear. The CROWN-ACC product is the appropriate choice as it includes catalog accessories for MV switchgear, which would be stored in the equipment enclosure as specified.
